info.name: Study Tracker API
info.description: REST API for Study Tracker with email verification, forgot-password code flow, and encoded ID support

request.description: Register account (initially inactive) and send verification email
Resend verification email for unverified user
Authenticate verified active user and get access token
Refresh access token using refresh token
Send 6-digit reset code to email (max one email every 30 minutes per user).
Verify reset code and set new password (max 5 successful resets per month).

query.description: Date for agenda (YYYY-MM-DD format, default: today)

request.description: Get daily stats and agenda for authenticated user
Get detailed topic info with all related tasks and practice logs
Create new topic with automatic revision tasks (day 1, 7, 30, 90)
Get tasks for a specific date, grouped by type (learn, revision, practice, overdue)
Reschedule task to a new date (not available if already completed)

Complete a task (locks its date). For revision tasks send recall_grade (again|hard|good|easy) and optional review_seconds (1-3600): a graded revision re-plans the topic's other pending/missed revisions from today; the response includes schedule_outcome. Ungraded completion keeps other dates. A late learn completion re-anchors the plan. difficulty_feedback is deprecated.

query.description: problem_solving, implementation, reading, note_making, mock_interview, other

request.description: Get selected useful profile fields for authenticated user
Update profile fields (email cannot be changed).
Get current user revision spacing configuration (or fallback defaults).
Reset user templates and fallback to system defaults.
Returns the user's study preferences merged over defaults (review budget, debt threshold, minutes per review, weekly new-topic cap, week start, off days, success threshold).
Partial update; only sent keys change. study_profile (job_holder|student) selects weekly gear templates. review_debt_threshold_minutes must not be below the budget. Demo users get 403.
Due-today estimate (due_topics, estimated_minutes, budget, over_budget) plus review-debt, weekly new-topic cap and never-miss-twice flags. date defaults to today.
Question-first review queue: one review per topic, overdue oldest first, today's reviews interleaved across categories, within_budget split and grade_preview per item.
Your schedule for this category, or null with the fallback that applies.
Set a preset or custom offsets (+ repeat). Demo users get 403.
Revert the category to your default schedule.
